scope: Make Publish 14 weapon attack speeds authoritative for player cadence, authored default weapons, and weapon presentation while preserving legitimate crafted variation and retaining expansion-only weapons through PRE-CU family fallbacks; the base unarmed template is authored at 2.0 seconds and player initialization must not rewrite it to the NGE 0.50-second value. AI cadence uses Core3's separate two-second queue interval.

migrationPolicy.policy: Normalize a new or persisted weapon only when its current speed is nonpositive or less than half of its exact Publish 14 speed (or family fallback).
migrationPolicy.runtimeFallback: The combat-facing getter returns the authoritative speed for any stale default or lazily loaded weapon that bypassed object-load normalization.
migrationPolicy.craftedVariation: Values at or above the threshold remain untouched.
migrationPolicy.expansionOnlyWeapons: Use the median PRE-CU cadence for the weapon family.

queuePolicy.primaryAttack: live normalized weapon speed with neutral multiplier
queuePolicy.restoredPublish14Special: live normalized weapon speed times authenticated override multiplier
queuePolicy.expansionAttack: live normalized weapon speed times neutral multiplier
queuePolicy.aiAttack: fixed two-second Core3 command-queue interval before inherited creature speed modifiers

liveBeforeEvidence.diagnosis: NGE-scaled persisted/template speeds collapse to the queue's one-second minimum and make player and creature combat execute at NGE cadence.

artifactGates: Scout direct and droid bytecode gates
WeaponObject normalization and fail-closed accessor symbols

priorLiveAfterEvidence.staleDefaultWeaponCoverage: The persisted unarmed row remained 0.5 in this historical run, while the compiled combat-facing accessor returned the authoritative 2.0-second value immediately. This gap is the source defect closed by direct-source commit 93878e4b3350f1e9391cd2bde25b3727243b6608.

Run the zero-class full Java build and compile object/weapon/melee/unarmed/unarmed_default_player.iff from the authenticated template.
Run the full x64 server build and deployment probes, including base_player bytecode, compiled default-unarmed IFF, WeaponObject archive symbols, and the mapped ELF64 SwgGameServer binary.

Live-test a fresh/default weapon and a persisted player: stored unarmed speed is 2.0, player cadence follows the authenticated formula, and AI retains its separate two-second queue interval.
